section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a comparison of means indicating that Latent Inhibition (LI) scores in a preexposed condition were significantly reduced in high-scoring groups of the Creative Personality Scale (CPS) and the originality dimension of divergent thinking tasks, as well as in overall divergent thinking. Nonparametric Mann–Whitney U tests yielded similar results, with a reference to Table 2 for further details.
